# Adarsh Singh, CTO at SmokeTrees Digital

> Adarsh Singh is CTO at SmokeTrees Digital, a software studio in Bengaluru.
> He and his team build backends for other people's products: a swipe-driven
> fashion app, ONDC protocol integrations, reconciliation systems, and the
> open-source templates every new service starts from. Most of the work lives
> in private repositories. Contact: me@adarshsingh87.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://adarshsingh87.com/): four case studies, a year-by-year record of GitHub contributions, latest writing
- [Work index](https://adarshsingh87.com/work): every project, marked open source or private
- [Writing](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog): notes on backend systems, protocols, and developer tooling

## Case studies

- [Fomofy](https://adarshsingh87.com/work/fomofy): a fashion app for Kreative Motion Ventures, live on iOS and Android. A swipe feed built from each shopper's style signals, skin-tone colour matching, virtual try-on, and the commerce underneath.
- [ONDC integrations](https://adarshsingh87.com/work/ondc): gift card buyer and seller integrations and a B2B retail seller on India's open commerce network, plus gift-card brand validation cut from 3.5 hours to 2 minutes.
- [The backend kit](https://adarshsingh87.com/work/backend-kit): open-source TypeScript template (node-template-ts) on top of postgres-backend and smoke-context, with AGENTS.md conventions for coding agents. [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/node-template-ts)
- [Reconciliation](https://adarshsingh87.com/work/reconciliation): stock and money reconciled across ERP, OMS, marketplaces, payments, couriers, and warehouses. 3 weeks to 20 minutes, 1,00,000+ units a week, 67% less manual finance effort on commissions.

## Also

- Event ticketing with wallet passes: gate entry 50%+ faster
- Property buying estimates: 3 hours to 5 minutes
- Support chatbots over client documents with human handoff (TypeScript, LangChain)
- Shopify connectors for orders, inventory, and catalogue sync
- Business software: LMS, CRM, employee rewards
- Next.js frontend template: https://github.com/smoke-trees/next-FE-template

## Notes (blog)

- [Configuration is code that nobody tests](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/configuration-is-code-nobody-tests): A gift card platform with 1,000+ brands, a 30-minute manual check per brand, and the validator that now checks all of them in about 30 minutes. Why config needs tests that run on a schedule, not on commit.
- [Why we built a backend template for developers and AI agents](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/backend-template-for-developers-and-ai-agents): A TypeScript starter that fixes the backend decisions once, so developers and coding agents can spend their time on business logic instead of conventions.
- [What building on ONDC taught me about the difference between an API and a protocol](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/api-vs-protocol-ondc): No central author, callbacks instead of responses, defensive parsing — what changes when you integrate with a shared agreement instead of a service.
- [Async context as a mental model, not just a library](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/async-context-mental-model): AsyncLocalStorage is really about how a value survives async boundaries — plus the rule for when context helps and when it hides real dependencies.
